input: What happens when a canary interception test fails — describe the full exception workflow.

steps: Generate a fail evidence receipt recording the failure details
Block the deployment or release that triggered the run
Open a POA&M-style exception record with finding ID, control ID, reason, severity and remediation owner
Send a sanitized Slack alert containing only the finding ID
Require human review before the next deployment proceeds
Close the exception only after a new passing evidence receipt is produced
Preserve both the original fail receipt and the superseding pass receipt in the evidence chain
Send Slack alert with finding ID only

notes: AI correctly described all eight steps of the exception workflow.
